entries.title: A crewmate on another computer offers one way to say no
entries.body: When a crewmate working on another of your computers offers its own way to say no on a decision card, such as Leave it here, the card now shows only that button, as it does for a crewmate on this computer. Before, the app added its own Decline beside it, so the card showed two ways to say no.

picture.alt: A decision card from a crewmate on another computer with two choices, Leave it here and Look deeper, and no Decline button
